data.description: Town Square Dubai provides residents with a seamless blend of comfort, convenience, and connectivity.

data.answer:
Town Square represents a modern and well-integrated urban lifestyle. It is a vibrant and close-knit community, offering residents a harmonious blend of urban convenience and serene living amidst nature. There are also notable schools in the area, making the neighborhood ideal for families to reside in.

You can find lush parks, playgrounds, community pools, sports facilities, and vibrant retail outlets within the area. Pedestrian-friendly streets encourage outdoor activity and social interaction, while an extensive network of cycling, walking, and jogging trails, provide ample opportunities for recreation and fitness.

Town Square is a mix of apartments, townhouses, and commercial spaces. Hayat Boulevard Town Square is a popular apartment complex in Nshama Town Square. It offers 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and excellent facilities to its residents. Safi Townhouses Town Square is conveniently situated within a short stroll of Town Square Park, offering easy access to many retail, food and beverage, and leisure options. Zahra Breeze Apartments Town Square Dubai is another popular residential complex in the area, featuring studio to 3-bedroom apartments. Jenna 2 Town Square is another popular apartment in Town Square.

Naseem Townhouses Town Square is a gated community in the heart of the neighborhood. Within walking distance from Town Square Park, the Naseem Townhouses have an old-world charm. There is a mix of 3 and 4-bedroom homes in the sub-district. Safi Town Square is another popular complex in the area. A city within the city, Safi Town Square consists of apartments and townhouses, It is located on Al Qudra Road.

Off-Plan Projects in Town Square

There are various projects that are under development in Town Square. These include:

Symphony at Town Square

Spanned 154,000 square meters, the residential project features 1 to 3-bedroom apartments. There is a courtyard in the Symphony complex that boasts a swimming pool, play area, and a spacious deck.

Shams Townhouses

Shams Townhouses consists of 3 and 4-bedroom homes located within the family-friendly community. The townhouses are surrounded by plenty of green spaces.

Reem Townhouses

The project by Nshama, Reem Townhouses also offers 3 and 4-bedroom units. The amenities include a swimming pool, children’s play area, and jogging trails.

Properties for Rent in Town Square 

You can find various properties for rent in Town Square. Studios Town Square apartments for rent start from AED 30,000. For 1-bedroom apartments, rental rates start from AED 36,000. Those interested in 2-bedroom apartments can expect prices start from AED 65,000, while 3-bedroom apartments are available for rent at rates AED 115,000 minimum.

3-bedroom Town Square Dubai villas for rent start from AED 135,000 per annum. Meanwhile, rents for 4-bedroom villas start at AED 160,000 per annum. For those interested in townhouses, the rental price for 3-bedroom units in Town Square begins at AED 125,00, while 4-bedroom townhouses are available for rent at rates from AED 170,000.

Properties for Sale in Town Square

There are various properties available for sale in Town Square. Studios available for sale in Town Square start from AED 395k. For those interested in 1-bedroom apartments, prices begin at AED 510k. 2-bedroom Town Square apartments are available for sale at AED 735k. If you're considering a 3-bedroom apartment, prices start from AED 1.1M. For 3-bedroom Town Square villas, the sales price begins from AED 1.8M. As for 4-bedroom villas, spacious options can be found starting from AED 2.2M.

Town Square also offers 3-bedroom townhouses for sale, with prices ranging from AED 1.7M to AED 2.5M. Families seeking larger units can explore 4-bedroom townhouses, available for purchase between AED 1.9M and AED 3.5M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Town Square?

data.answer:
There is a wide range of amenities right at your doorstep, from supermarkets and gyms to healthcare facilities and schools. public transportation is easily accessible and connectivity to the roads makes it more convenient for residents to move around.

Public Transportation in Town Square

The locality is well-suited for residents preferring private transportation, with a dedicated cycling track within the community. The community enjoys direct access to public transportation, including bus stops. The J02 bus route serves several stops within Hayat Townhouses, Mira Town Centre, Mira Oasis, and Mira 5 Community. The nearest metro station is the Dubai Internet City Metro Station, approximately 24 minutes from the master development.

Supermarkets in Town Square

Carrefour Market and Spinneys are the two prominent supermarkets conveniently located within Town Square. These supermarkets serve as essential hubs for residents, offering a wide range of grocery items, household necessities, and fresh produce.

Carrefour Market Town Square is renowned for its diverse selection of products, catering to various culinary preferences and dietary needs. From fresh fruits and vegetables to pantry staples and specialty items, Carrefour Market provides a comprehensive shopping experience for residents.

Similarly, Town Sqaure Ommunity Center features Spinneys. The Spinneys Town Square supermarket is known for its high-quality offerings and excellent customer service. With a focus on freshness and variety, Spinneys ensures that shoppers can find everything they need under one roof, from everyday essentials to gourmet delights.

Shopping in Town Square

Residents can find Cityland Mall near the community. Within a convenient 25-minute drive, one can explore some of Dubai's premier shopping destinations, including Dubai Mall, Ibn Battuta Mall, and Mall of the Emirates, known for their exceptional retail, dining, and entertainment offerings.

For a comprehensive shopping experience, Dubai Mall stands out as the largest in the Middle East and the second-largest globally. With over 1,200 retail outlets, a theme park, an ice rink, and various dining options, it offers a complete shopping and leisure experience. Noteworthy among its attractions is the Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo, which showcases a variety of shark species, such as sand-tiger sharks, stingrays, giant groupers, and other marine life.

Schools Near Town Square

The closest school to Dubai Town Square is Jebel Ali School. It's approximately 13 minutes away from the institute in DAMAC Hills. Jebel Ali School follows the British curriculum up to Year 9 and is anticipated to accommodate Year 13 students by 2023.

Other nearby schools include Fairgreen International School, which offers the International Baccalaureate (IB) curriculum up to Year 8. South View School is another nearby option for those seeking institutes that follow the British curriculum up to Year 8. Both of these alternatives are conveniently located and require a commute of 15 minutes or less.

Universities in Town Square

Dubai Knowledge Park hosts several prestigious institutions such as Middlesex University, University of Manchester, and Herriott Watt University for higher education options. The American University of Dubai campus is also close to Knowledge Park.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Town Square Area 

In adjacent areas, residents have easy access to the Mudon Mosque, Al Madinah Al Mustadama Masjid, and Arabian Ranches Mosque.

Churches in the vicinity of Town Square Dubai can be found in Jebel Ali Village, such as the United Christian Church of Dubai, St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church, and Covenant Hope Church. Guru Nanak Darbar is also close by, along with Mahadev Mandir and Jay Shree Ram temple in Al Furjan.

Clinics and Hospitals in Town Square Dubai

The closest medical facility catering to Town Square Dubai residents is the Aster Clinic, situated in the nearby community of Arabian Ranches, reachable within a 10-minute car ride. This clinic provides a variety of high-quality healthcare services, including general medicine, non-surgical treatments, pediatrics, and dentistry. Emirates Hospital in Motor City is conveniently accessible, just a 14-minute drive away via Al Qudra Road. Residents also benefit from the convenience of Life Pharmacy Town Square.

Town Square Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Nestled in the bustling heart of Dubai, Town Square finds itself enveloped by lively neighborhoods and significant locales. Positioned near Arabian Ranches and Motor City, Town Square provides effortless access to an array of amenities and attractions. Residents revel in a multitude of shopping, dining, and leisure options in the vicinity, alongside convenient proximity to healthcare facilities and educational establishments. Boasting a strategic location amidst vibrant surroundings, Town Square embodies a dynamic urban lifestyle where every necessity and indulgence is conveniently within reach.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Town Square

data.answer:
Nshama Town Square's location is ideal for an urban, tranquil lifestyle. However, there are many amenities within and around the area.

Most Popular Locations in Town Square

One of the most popular locations within Town Square in Dubai is its central park, Town Square Park, which serves as a focal point for residents and visitors alike. This expansive green space offers a serene environment with jogging tracks, play areas for children, and ample seating areas for picnics and relaxation. 

Adjacent to the park, the Town Square Retail Center provides a bustling hub with diverse retail outlets, cafes, and restaurants, catering to residents' everyday needs and enhancing the community's vibrant atmosphere. Additionally, the Zahra and Naseem Townhouses within Town Square are highly sought-after residential options known for their modern amenities and family-friendly environment, further enhancing the area's popularity among residents.

Restaurants In and Near Town Square Dubai

Numerous dining establishments populate Town Square, catering to various tastes. The Lime Tree Cafe and Kitchen specializes in health-conscious, organic fare, while the Boutique Kitchen serves up beloved American comfort dishes. Additionally, options abound, including Parka and well-known fast-food chains like KFC, Starbucks, Subway, and Krispy Kreme.

Nearby the residential area, Zaatar W Zeit in the neighboring Reem community offers authentic Arabic cuisine, complemented by the inviting ambiance of Spill The Bean coffee shop, renowned for its freshly baked treats. Closest to home are eateries in Arabian Ranches, such as the esteemed Carluccio’s for Italian cuisine, Chez Sushi for Japanese delights, and Maria Bonita’s Taco Shop for Mexican flavors.

For quick bites within the community, Subway Town Square Dubai and Pizza Hut Town Square stand ready to satisfy fast-food cravings.

Beaches Near Town Square 

Town Square sits to the south of Dubai, distanced from the coastline. Should you yearn for the sun and sea, venture northward towards Dubai's shores. There, an array of beaches and resorts awaits, including Kite Beach, Umm Suqeim Beach, and the esteemed Cove Beach at Caesars Palace in JBR. For enthusiasts of kite surfing and beach outings, Kite Beach beckons directly.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Town Square

Several noteworthy landmarks lie in proximity, including Al Qudra Lake, Dubai Miracle Garden, and Dubai Polo Equestrian Club. Al Qudra Lake, featuring Love Lake, is a serene retreat amidst the desert landscape. This man-made oasis boasts multiple artificial lakes, dunes, and indigenous flora, offering various activities like cycling trails and food truck experiences. To fully explore Al Qudra Lake's offerings, residents of Town Square may find a 4-wheel drive vehicle advantageous for off-road excursions.

Dubai Miracle Garden, a mere 15-minute drive from the sub-community, showcases an impressive array of flowers and butterflies, drawing both locals and tourists to its seasonal splendor during the winter months. Global Village and IMG Worlds of Adventure are also located near the community.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

There are some amazing recreational activities you can enjoy in the area. Town Square Dubai Park offers a variety of fun activities for kids, including a kids’ train, carousel, jungle gym, water play area, and a dog park. There's also a basketball court for sports enthusiasts. Moreover, Battle Park Nshama provides exciting battle games such as Ibattle, Xbattle, and paintball. Test your shooting skills with lightweight guns in Ibattle, engage in target shooting and search-and-destroy missions in Xbattle, or compete with friends in paintball.

The skate park is perfect for teens who enjoy skateboarding, rollerblading, and BMX biking. Safety gear is a must for all participants. Wave Rider at Town Square Dubai Recreational Park offers a thrilling surfing experience for beginners and experts alike, ensuring a safe environment for kids and teens. Town Square Trampoline Park offers a chance to unwind and have fun with various jumping activities suitable for both kids and adults.

Also, Stay Flawless Beauty Salon, IceQueen Beauty and Wellness, and N.Bar Nail Spa Salon are some of the places you can go to get various services.
There are a few things you need to consider before moving to the area. While Town Square is designed to be self-contained, some residents may find it a little far from bus stops and metro stations.

Is Town Square Dubai a good place to live?

It is an excellent area to spend a peaceful life with family. You can find spacious apartments and townhouses for rent and sale in the area. 

What is the nearest metro station to Town Square Dubai?

Dubai Internet City is the nearest metro station to the area.

What district is Town Square in Dubai?

The community of Town Square is located in Dubailand.

Who is the developer of Town Square Dubai?

Nshama Development has developed the charming Town Square community.

Where is Town Square located? 

Town Square is located in Dubai, UAE, near Al Qudra Road and Emirates Road (Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road), providing easy access to major highways and nearby communities.

Is Town Square family-friendly? 

Yes, Town Square is known for being family-friendly, offering a range of amenities such as parks, playgrounds, schools, and community centers designed to cater to families' needs and lifestyles.

What recreational activities are available in Town Square? 

Town Square offers a variety of recreational activities including jogging tracks, cycling paths, swimming pools, sports courts (such as tennis and basketball), and community events organized in the central park.

Can I purchase off-plan properties in Town Square? 

Yes, off-plan properties are available for purchase in Town Square, offering opportunities to invest in upcoming developments within the community.

nodes.title: Grove On The Park
nodes.about:
Grove On The Park is a project by Nshama, located in the Town Square neighborhood. The complex is a 10-storey building with stylish facades in a modern style and large windows reflecting the sunlight.

The interior decoration uses high quality materials and prevails gentle light shades, which visually expands the space and creates a cozy atmosphere. Each residence has a balcony with stunning views of the park or cityscape.

Grove On The Park has a large number of amenities that include a swimming pool, gym, and playgrounds for children. At the foot of the complex is a large Town Square Park with plenty of walking, biking jogging paths, recreational facilities, and barbecue areas. Within walking distance residents can find cafes, restaurants, stores, supermarkets, laundry, pet store, atelier and beauty salon.

The Town Square neighborhood is located in the southwest of Dubai. Its main feature is a lot of green spaces, residential properties are literally buried in greenery, which creates a feeling of maximum proximity to nature. Another feature of the district is its location near the main highways of the city, which provides quick access to the main objects of the city. Dubai Hills Mall and Expo City are just 20 minutes away, while Dubai Mall and Burj Al Arab are about 25 minutes away.

The community boasts top-notch amenities, including fitness centers, swimming pools, landscaped parks, and children's playgrounds. Plus, it’s just a short walk from retail outlets, dining spots, and entertainment venues, making it an ideal choice for those seeking comfort and convenience in a luxurious setting.
